atoms.b: To convert a decimal number with one decimal place to a fraction, just write the digit after the decimal point as the ((++numerator denominator)) and 10 as the ((numerator ++denominator)).
To convert a decimal number with two decimal places to a fraction, just write the digits after the decimal point as the ((++numerator denominator)) and 100 as the ((numerator ++denominator)).

Often, it is useful to then write the fraction in its simplest form.

25/100=1/4
